scope: All-record structural inventory plus individual primary-source research of the three listed projects. Not a factual audit of all 1000.
authorship: Codex AI assistant: primary-source reading and original synthesis. No independent reviewer or hands-on product testing.

findings.problem: Old third-party pricing text said no trial; current official Free-plan documentation describes a paid-feature trial. Generic API/version-control labels obscured actual workflows.
findings.resolution: Replaced the introduction, features, pricing and FAQ; added specific workflow, mapping, timing, billing and recovery explanations.

findings.problem: Cloud-only directory deployment metadata omitted self-hosting, edition differences, the item model and license scope.
findings.resolution: Changed display name to n8n without changing identity/slug; documented Cloud/self-hosting, editions, execution model, tests versus production, recovery and fair-code conditions.

findings.problem: Generic real-time sync and compliance labels did not explain trigger timing, bundle multiplication, billing or recovery conditions.
findings.resolution: Removed unsupported generic claims; documented scheduling, credits, bundles, routing, explicit recovery settings and transaction boundaries. Paid normalized price stays unknown.

competitor_review.observation: The retrieved page combines a product introduction, broad feature/benefit claims, user reviews and alternatives. Its introduction, feature section and opinion section use different integration-count figures.
competitor_review.editorial_inference: Dated primary-source conditions and worked workflow/billing explanations offer a concrete content opportunity. This does not establish that 123Charts outranks SaaSHub.

search_guidance.interpretation: Provide original useful answers, accessible text and traceable evidence. Word counts, FAQ counts or special AI markup are not proof of SEO/GEO competitiveness.
